description_zh: 调用RenameDbfs重命名一个数据库文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs rename-dbfs --fs-name NewDbfsName --fs-id dbfs-GOrr00000000Yd0VLOyBpg --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenameDbfs

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the DBFS.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
重命名后的数据库文件系统名称。

取值范围：长度为2~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线和连字符（-）
parameters.name: fs_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the DBFS instance is located. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
